urls.rationale: Chapter 4 (Secretary of the Commonwealth) §§ 2.2-400 through 2.2-435 — houses the lobbying-disclosure article (§§ 2.2-418 to 2.2-435), administered by the Virginia Conflict of Interest and Ethics Advisory Council.

notes: Regime prior labeled lobbying as 'Chapter 4.4'; the actual 2025 Title 2.2 TOC shows Chapter 4.4 is 'Office of the Children's Ombudsman'. The §§ 2.2-418 to 2.2-435 lobbying section range falls within Chapter 4 (Secretary of the Commonwealth, §§ 2.2-400 through 2.2-435). Chapter 31 (State and Local Government Conflict of Interests Act) is conflict-of-interest, not lobbying disclosure proper — excluded. Pass-2 returned the full chapter list directly under title-2-2/ with no subtitle/part intermediate layer.
